name: Bois Brule River (Brule River State Forest)
gaugeName: BOIS BRULE RIVER AT BRULE, WI
blurb: The Bois Brule River through the Brule River State Forest between WDNR designated canoe landings, with WDNR times between landings.

timing.note: A reviewed speed/flow calibration has not been established. Access and guide information remain available.

sections.notes: Markers identify agency-listed access; the map states whether a landing or an approximate facility area has been reviewed. notices.title: No inflatables or motorized boats on these sections
notices.text: Use a permitted canoe or kayak and designated canoe landings. DNR prohibits inflatables and motors here; its motor exception is only within one mile of the Lake Superior mouth, outside these sections.
notices.sourceName: Wisconsin DNR — paddling the Bois Brule

notices.title: Distance needs confirmation
notices.text: Wisconsin DNR describes Stone Chimney to Stones Bridge as 4.5 miles, while the imported geometry gives 2.5 miles. Confirm the intended Stone Chimney landing and channel before relying on the listed mileage.
